cases.command: n=0; for v in ' 1' $'\r1' $'\t1' '+1' '.5' '1.' '1e2' '+.5e1' '0x10' '0x1p4' '0x.8p1' '0x10.8' inf infinity INF 00; do tail -s "$v" -n1 /data/a.txt > /dev/null && n=$((n+1)); done; echo accepted=$n; tail --sleep-interval=0.5 -n1 /data/a.txt

n=0; for v in $'1\r' '1 ' $'1\t' '' 1_0 1x 0x 1e 1e+ 1,5 . 1.5.5 0xp1 'inf inity' -1 nan NAN 'nan(x)' 1xé $'1x\r' $'1x\177' "1x'" '1x\'; do tail -s "$v" /data/a.txt || n=$((n+1)); done; echo refused=$n
